hero_subtitle: Compile standard annotated Python into ultra-fast, zero-dependency native executables. No separate runtime to bundle, zero container bloat.
metric_1_desc: Geometric mean speedup across compute kernels vs CPython 3.14.9 (Linux x86_64).
metric_2_desc: Lower peak RSS on the same kernel group. Pack more tasks onto leaner instances.
metric_3_desc: Typical standalone native binary. No separate runtime to ship with it.
metric_4_desc: Single self-contained file for programs inside the supported subset. Zero dependencies, zero virtualenvs to ship.
parity_title: Write standard Python. Keep stdout parity on the supported subset.
parity_subtitle: No new language to learn and no rewrite in Rust or C++. pyscriptc turns standard typed Python into high-performance native machine code with zero guessing.
parity_guarantee_desc: Unlike JIT engines that deoptimize unpredictably when types fluctuate at runtime, pyscriptc statically resolves your types at compile time. What compiles runs with steady, guaranteed native latency.
parity_sem_desc: 64-bit integers (overflow aborts), IEEE-754 floats, and standard exception handling preserved. Numbered divergences are documented.
parity_diag_desc: Actionable diagnostic codes highlight untyped constructs before shipping to production.
surfaces_subtitle: Produce the exact executable format needed across your application architecture.
surface_1_desc: Single-file executable with zero runtime dependencies. 22.8x faster execution and lower peak memory for microservices and CLI tools.
surface_2_desc: Opt-in fallback to the host CPython runtime for code that cannot be compiled yet. The compiled core still runs at native speed.
surface_2_integration_v: Opt-in tier, measured in the benchmark suite
surface_3_desc: Export typed Python as a shared library with a ctypes loader, or as a static library with generated headers for embedding. Foreign-language callers are on the roadmap.
surface_3_deployment_v: CPython via ctypes today; Rust, Go, C++ planned
cross_subtitle: Target any cloud, server, or edge architecture with a single flag. No multi-gigabyte Docker build containers, no complex cross-toolchain setup headaches.
cta_title: Ready to ship Python as native code?
cta_subtitle: Start compiling typed Python into standalone executables in under two minutes.
footer_tagline: Compile standard typed Python to standalone native binaries. No separate runtime to bundle.
